reasons: Covers the reset scope, the restore, and the refusal rules.

terms.meaning: One of the two built-in demo cases that can be reset.

sections.name: File setup, request
sections.title: Setup and request helper
sections.what: Loads the test tools, the reset route, and several services. Defines a helper that sends a reset request.
sections.why: Same reason as the other route tests.

sections.name: seed-only demo reset
sections.title: Reset scope tests
sections.what: Checks that reset restores the hero case, clears its packets and records, keeps other cases intact, and refuses unknown or extra-field requests.
sections.why: Protects against deleting more than intended.
sections.watch_out: The expected nickname and geometry id are fixed seed values.

summary: Tests that the demo reset restores one approved demo case and leaves all other cases alone, and refuses requests for arbitrary cases.
purpose: Protects data from accidental wipes during demo resets.
why: Likely reason: resets delete data, so the rules must be tightly checked.
how: Creates an extra case, adds a review packet and an official record to the hero case, runs the reset, and checks the extra case still exists, the packets and records are cleared, the hero name is restored, the hero geometry is restored, and the extra case has no geometry. A second test sends an unknown case and an extra field and expects 400 both times.
inputs: Demo case id and a newly created extra case.
risks: The test depends on the exact seed nickname for the hero case.
debug: Check the reset logic in the case service if the hero case is not restored.
